title: Excellent tour, must book
text:
Me and my mum were taken on the tour with Victor. He was brilliant. Very knowledgeable about the city, very passionate about the history and culture of Barcelona and Catalunya. He gave us great recommendations of place to see and where best to go next. 
I would recommend this tour. The hour was great but we could have enjoyed it for another hour. The tuk tuk was brilliant and the driving was smooth and safe!
author: honestm2018

title: Tom, a top-notch guide to discover Barcelona differently!!!
text:
A big thank you to Tom for this superb tuk-tuk ride! A top-notch guide, friendly and passionate, with captivating explanations about Barcelona. A great experience to discover the city in a different way! We recommend it 100%!!! 💯🙏👍🤩
From the 4 Alsatians 😜
